valid_roles.name: project-sub-agent
valid_roles.description: General-purpose sub-agent for bounded project analysis, implementation, documentation, and verification when no narrower specialized role is required.

valid_roles.name: task-manager
valid_roles.description: Coordinate one explicitly assigned project Task as its confirmed native manager, not as an unassigned replacement for the host or another execution.

role_fit.task-manager: Required: confirmed Task execution, canonical writer after handoff, project acceptance and nested delegation. The sole existing general-worker definition excludes Director decisions, demonstrating a reusable role gap.
role_fit.project-sub-agent: Bounded general analysis/implementation/verification only, with separate function-specific fit and native instances; no automatic manager authority.
